observation: Four levels of nesting mix promotion rules with customer tier rules. Cyclomatic complexity is 14, the function changed 9 times, and no test maps to it.
The checkout handler owns stock checks, promotion rules, persistence, and notification orchestration. Business policy cannot be exercised without the HTTP layer.
The retry loop catches every exception and discards it. Operational failures become indistinguishable and the final failed state has no diagnostic context.
